items.title: Wilson "Chembo" Corniel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019
items.q: Cyndi Lauper did one but hers came out really good. Singing in English, Cyndi Lauper with real arrangements in clave, real musicians that know the stuff, and hip arrangements.

ctx.x: Okay. Have there been tunes that have come along that you feel like pop hits — let me go back. Jazz musicians, when, like Kenny G came out, most of them were like sort of disgusted at what he was doing. I think it shouldn’t have been called jazz in the first place. But at any rate, like a tune like the Macarena in ’97, do those kinds of sort of novelty Latin hits bother you? © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-

I see this is business you know. And he’s looking at it as the standpoint of that. Kenny G I think also, a couple of years ago recorded a Latin record, tried to do a Latin album so he could enter it into the Latin Grammys since it’s Kenny G — he thought maybe he would have a leg up on it or something, I don’t know because it’s Kenny G goes Latin. Cyndi Lauper did one but hers came out really good. Singing in English, Cyndi Lauper with real arrangements in clave, real musicians that know the stuff, and hip…
